title: Gujarat Super League
wikitext:
{{Short description|Association football league in India}} {{Use dmy dates|date=December 2023}} {{Use Indian English|date=December 2023}} {{Infobox football league | name = Gujarat Super League | logo = Gujarat Super League.svg | upright = 1.2 | organiser = [[Gujarat State Football Association]] | country = India | founded = {{start date and age|2024}} | teams = 6 | promotion = | season = | champions = Vadodara Warriors (1st title) | tv = [[Gujarat State Football Association|GSFA]] ([[YouTube]]) | website = {{URL|https://gsfa.in/gujarat-super-league/|GSL}} | current = [[2025 Gujarat Super League]] }} The '''Gujarat Super League''' is a men's [[Professional sports league organization|franchise]] [[association football|football]] league in the state of [[Gujarat]], organized by the [[Gujarat State Football Association]].{{Cite web |title=Inaugural season of six-team Gujarat Super League to kick off on May 1 |url=https://www.the-aiff.com/article/inaugural-season-of-six-team-gujarat-super-league-to-kick-off-on-may-1 |access-date=2024-04-26 |website=www.the-aiff.com}} The competition consisted of 6 teams in the initial season. All the matches are hosted at [[EKA Arena]] in [[Ahmedabad]].{{Cite web |last=DeshGujarat |date=2024-03-28 |title=Gujarat Super League to Revolutionize Football Landscape in Gujarat |url=https://deshgujarat.com/2024/03/28/gujarat-super-league-to-revolutionize-football-landscape-in-gujarat/ |access-date=2024-04-06 |website=DeshGujarat |language=en-US}} == Format == It is held in a single [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin format]], with the top two teams at the end of the league stage contesting the final. The players will be selected by [[Draft (sports)|draft]]. In the inaugural draft, 250 players from Gujarat will be included.{{cite web |date=25 April 2024 |title=Gujarat Super League trophy unveiled |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad/gujarat-super-league-trophy-unveiled/articleshow/109576456.cms}} == Teams == {{Location map+|Gujarat|float=right|width=350|caption=Locations of the GSL teams|places= {{Location map~ |Gujarat |lat=23.1323 |long=72.390 |label_size=90 |label={{nowrap|Gandhinagar Giants}} |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Gujarat |lat=22.3000 |long=70.7833 |label_size=90 |label={{nowrap|Saurashtra Spartans}} |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Gujarat |lat=22.18 |long=73.12 |label_size=90 |label={{nowrap|Vadodara Warriors}} |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Gujarat |lat=21.1702 |long=72.8311 |label_size=90 |label={{nowrap|Surat Strikers}} |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Gujarat |lat=23.0121 |long=72.3417 |label_size=90 |label='''Ahmedabad''' |mark=Blue pog.svg |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |India3 |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |marksize=1 |lat=10.00 |long=68.00 |label_size=90 |label='''{{nowrap|[[Ahmedabad]] teams:}}'''

Individually, the best players in eight different categories will get a prize money of ₹25,000 each on the basis of their performance throughout the tournament. == Broadcasting == After the [[Santosh Trophy]], the GSL became the second Indian football tournament to be streamed globally on FIFA+. It was also streamed on [[Gujarat State Football Association|GSFA]] official [https://www.youtube.com/@gujaratstatefootballassoci9827?themeRefresh=1 YouTube channel]. == See also == * [[Gujarat SFA Club Championship]] * [[Kerala Super League]] == References == {{reflist}} [[Category:Football in Gujarat]] [[Category:Regional football leagues in India]] [[Category:2024 establishments in Gujarat]] [[Category:Sports leagues established in 2024]]
extract: The Gujarat Super League is a men's franchise football league in the state of Gujarat, organized by the Gujarat State Football Association. The competition consisted of 6 teams in the initial season. All the matches are hosted at EKA Arena in Ahmedabad.
